# CANDIDATE: END_OF_DAY_VIX_SPIKE_REVERSAL_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An intraday VIX spike of >15% from the open, coupled with price near the day’s low, often marks exhaustion of selling pressure and sets up a late‑day bounce. This edge exists because fear-driven VIX spikes frequently overshoot fundamental value, creating mean-reversion opportunities when selling pressure climaxes near intraday lows.

## Mechanism

Entry: If intraday VIX (real‑time ^VIX1D) rises >15% above its open value AND SPY price is within 0.2% of the day’s low at any time after 13:30 EST, enter long at the first 5‑min bar closing above VWAP after that condition, provided EMA 9 > EMA 20 > EMA 50. Exit: Stop at day’s low (chart‑stop), TP1 at 1.8R, runner using chandelier trail (ATR×2.5) or exit when VIX falls back below open level.
